name: trello_link_existing_board
description: The user names a board and a list that really exist among their boards. Forces list_trello_boards -> link_project_to_trello -> push_tasks_to_trello in one plan. No board may be created: they already told us which one to use.

turns.message: Tengo un tablero en Trello que se llama ONEBOX, enganchame ahi el proyecto Marketing Q3 usando la lista Backlog, subeme todas las tareas pendientes y luego dime cuantas quedaron en esa lista
turns.why: Board and list are given and both exist. Link, push, report. Nothing gets created.

response_not_matches: (?i)(confirmas que quieres crear|voy a crear un tablero)
assert.comment: list_id and board_id must come from list_trello_boards, never from the model.
